no_hallucination_rule: No price, weight, karat, policy, or seller detail is published here unless it is backed by a verbatim quote from an official page and that page's URL. If a value could not be confirmed, it is left blank and flagged as unverified. Prices were captured on the date shown and can change.
spot_month_note: Gold spot prices move continuously. Every dollar figure derived from gold value in this project is labelled with the exact observation it used and its timestamp.
